name: WARNING: Badia Complete Seasoning (Sazón Completa with Dehydrated Onion & Garlic)
whyItWorks: Pervasive all-purpose Latin seasoning containing heavy amounts of dehydrated onion powder, garlic powder, monosodium glutamate, and tricalcium phosphate. High fructan fermentation trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid Sazón Completa blends. Use single-ingredient spices: ground cumin, dried oregano, and Redmond sea salt.
